text: Your book is empty. I am sorry. I would put something in it myself, if I had anything left.
The cash window is closed. Works regulation. Even now.
Entered in your book. One per cent a round. I have always liked a book that balances.
Lohnkasse, Werk Thalbach. Ilse Ruhland. The shift is gone and the pay is late, and I am still here. Please come to the window.
Good morning. I think it is morning. The savings book is open. Nobody has asked in three days.
It is me again! I put the cash box in the equipment locker when the siren went, and then the siren was the engines, and now I am very far up. Your book came with me.
Bordkasse, the quartermaster's locker. I know. I do not know what I am doing on an aeroplane either. Please do not open the hatches.
Here is your money. It is only paper. Everything here is only paper now.
They are coming through the yard! Oh no, oh no, please!
I only do the wages! I only do the wages!
